patch.value: Compare recursive answers with shared-source evidence and reserved budgets
Expose typed SDK and compact native CLI reconciliation of two explicitly budgeted decompositions. Preserve conflicting answers without treating agreement as truth.
Both arms share one immutable input boundary; Disagreement receipts preserve citations and costs; Reconciliation cannot exceed the caller reserved budget

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap recheck: host CLI has no recursive multi-answer reconciliation surface; pm-rlm replay certifies one execution, adaptive selects one decomposition, evidence verifies witness provenance; pm-rl evaluates labeled outcomes and candidate disagreement; pm-jev owns typed local decisions and policy replay. This feature owns caller-declared paired decompositions, one captured complete-list boundary, fixed arm reservations and non-truth answer comparisons. Use native PmClient complete reads, claims/comments and RLM run/ledger/evidence accounting.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation: paired caller partitions share one certified captured corpus and boundary digest; live history is refused in snapshot-only runs. Native RLM ledgers own recursion, witness verification/replay and accounting. Fixed arm budgets reserve later group first-step floors and global call slots. Exact text comparisons preserve both answers and citations without a truth claim. Typed admission refusals include remedies; operational failures preserve pending costs in partial receipts. Local targeted tests: 11/11 pass. Behavioral revert proof: 4/4 targeted regressions fail with the changed function protection reverted and exact bytes restored (reservation admission, immutable snapshot, disagreement labels, history boundary). Public read-only validation: 12 items, 54941 JSON bytes, 30 unchanged source files, 4 native runs, 10 model steps, 6 witnesses, 4 verified replays, 1 intentional disagreement and 2 equal strings; 44180 of 300000 accounting tokens charged; 2627-byte JSON result. Deterministic protocol fixture only, zero external inference, Git absent during execution. Existing development audit advisory is tracked by pm-rlm-wiav; production audit remains a CI gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Verification: pm test --run --progress ran both linked commands successfully (11 targeted tests plus 4 behavioral revert proofs); test result tracking is disabled by project policy, so the explicit summary is recorded here. Typecheck, lint, docstring and unchanged zero-duplication gates pass. Full npm and Bun release gates will run on CI to avoid adding load to the saturated host. Public tracker source records contain optional undefined SDK fields that JSON persistence omits; validation compares their exact serialized boundary bytes rather than JavaScript-only undefined properties.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI first head: strict tracker health passes in fresh checkouts, confirming local ancestor extension version skew is environmental. All measured sources reach unchanged 100/100/100/100 coverage, but CI correctly refuses the depth-one revert suite because the newly added proof script changes its explicit inventory from 9 to 10. Updated that inventory without weakening proof checks. Self-review also adds executable reconciliation CLI help and rejects malformed snapshot-only flags during ledger loading, with a fifth independent behavioral revert. Local pm-linked commands pass: 11 targeted tests and 5/5 behavioral proofs. Final CI rerun will verify the committed shallow-clone inventory and complete npm/Bun gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review round: audit every checkpoint, step, budget and terminal-evidence write. Reconciliation loads before its lease; adaptive cleanup can overwrite a completed root. Plan: enforce lease-scoped reads and stale-write refusal in the ledger, share guarded cleanup, test resume interleavings on one non-git tracker, prove behavioral revert, run targeted checks and npm/Bun CI release gates. Remote branch is current and main is already included.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented shared lease-before-load failure cleanup with skipped terminal-call receipts. Ledger saves enforce lease-scoped snapshot provenance and exact manifest comparison, then use native commitItemMutations match under the item lock. Completion reloads canonical saved calls and CAS-protects usage rows. Audited all source write paths in docs/CHECKPOINT-WRITES.md, including initialization, spawn, success, response/observation charges, nested failure, cleanup, legacy resume, transport cancellation, replay, parent receipts, settings and blob GC. Initial focused checks: 49/49 pass; subsequent reconciliation/adaptive/concurrency checks: 31/31 pass; direct SDK CAS regression: 1/1 pass. Additional nested and behavioral revert checks are running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: node test/reconcile-revert.ts passed 10/10. Removing only lease-before-load cleanup, terminal preservation, native SDK CAS, canonical completion counters, or read-start lease provenance causes targeted assertion failures; the five existing paired invariants also fail when reverted. Exact source bytes restored after every mutation. Sequential pm test --run --progress passes all three linked commands: 11/11 existing CLI/paired tests, 10/10 revert proofs, and 35/35 latest adaptive/paired/concurrency tests, with zero failed/skipped/canceled tests. An earlier overlapping mutation/test attempt was discarded and rerun sequentially. Project policy disables automatic test-result storage; this comment records the results. Pinned pm remains 2026.10.20 as required; registry current is 2026.10.24. Typecheck, lint, docstrings and unchanged zero-duplication check pass. Full exact-head npm/Bun release gates will run through manual CI.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Post-push coverage audit: 51/51 targeted storage, crash, cleanup and replay tests pass, including SIGKILL during blob and root publication. Added a native non-conflict error regression (3/3 pass: parent plus corrupt-history JSON and directory subcases) so CAS conflict conversion cannot swallow other SDK errors; both failures preserve the previous manifest. The earlier queued CI head is superseded by this test-only follow-up; final full-gate evidence will use its exact pushed head. No source behavior or thresholds changed after the 10/10 revert proof.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First final-head CI measured 100/100/100/100 across all 27 source files, but correctly failed two older shallow-clone proof scripts. The lease-free hydration mutation moved code into a helper without carrying the new read-entry lease token; its by-value mutation also targeted the pre-guard return statement. The empty-response revert now fails during canonical completion reload before reaching the later assertion. Updating only the proof transformations and explicit recovery assertion preserves the original behavioral obligations; no runtime protection or threshold is weakened. CI run 40078706744 records the failure, and full gates will be rerun on the corrected head.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Corrected legacy proof verification: node test/ledger-storage-revert.ts passes 15/15, and node test/revert.ts passes 51/51, including both empty-response reversions. All mutations restore original source bytes; git diff confirms no runtime source changes from these proof corrections. Latest linked reconciliation/adaptive/concurrency command passes 38/38 with zero fail/skip/cancel. The final runtime has already measured all four coverage dimensions at 100% across 27 source files in CI; corrected full npm/Bun gates remain pending.
